## Parking Control (PC) - Prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing street parking citywide or per district (your choice).
## Features - Choose Whole City, by District, or OFF in Options. - Uses game's own no-parking flag. - Parking lots and building parking continue to work normally.
## Good to know - Existing parked cars leave when their owners next use them. This may take several in-game months. - New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates the lanes (timing order). The mod then blocks new street parking; cars already there leave naturally. - For faster clearing, temporarily add a vanilla feature such as bike lanes or wide sidewalks. - When local parking is unavailable, CS2 may use outside-connection storage or staging as it does in vanilla. - Safe to remove: streets return to game default behavior. - The mod uses the game’s own no-parking flag and does not delete vehicles or touch bicycles.
## Support and Feedback - Don't forget the like button (top right) to give support for the mod. - Feedback and pull requests are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (right side icons). - Future plans include adding a UI for centralized parking fees.
